ark:
A mysterious natural phenomenon caused the Earth to be plunged into darkness. The world turned into an endless bloody chaos and mankind is on the brink of extinction...
Chu Yun Sheng, an ordinary white-collar worker, discovered his family heirloom book shining a bizarre light by accident. Out of curiosity, he tried to study the heirloom book.
After a long research, he still only understood a few symbols written in the ancient book. However, he was shocked when he figured out what messages the ancient book tried to tell him: the sun will disappear, and humanity is doomed...
He tried to spread the message, but no one believed him; his family and friends even tried to take him to see the psychiatrist. Eventually, he gave up telling anyone, but prepared for the apocalypse in secret.

blthe-villain-marries-the-barbarian-prin:
Lovell died in an apocalyptic world where love was fragile, trust was deadly, and survival demanded sacrifice.
When he awakens again, he is Amor Moons: a beautiful, wealthy noble heir inside a romance novel he knows far too well. But Amor is not the hero. He is the doomed love rival, written to chase Duke Alphonsins, humiliate himself before the heroine, and die pitifully so their love story can shine brighter.
Lovell refuses.
Now living as Amor, he abandons the duke before the story can destroy him and chooses the peaceful life he was never granted before: silk sheets, warm baths, sweet pastries, moonlit gardens, and the affection of a father who adores him. Yet the moment he steps away from fate, forgotten plots begin to awaken.
One of them arrives at his estate in the form of the Blackstone Tribe, northern warriors dismissed by the kingdom’s nobles as savage and uncivilized, though they are the very people who protect the borders from monsters. Among them is Valdor Rhazien, the chief’s eldest son: a massive, silent warrior with dangerous hands, disciplined restraint, and a gentleness Amor never expected.
To the court, Valdor is a barbarian.
To Amor, he is temptation.…

She used spells to tame a tiger as her mount, a black bear as her guardian, a wolf as a helper, and a monkey as the pathfinder. They went hunting together.

She planted herbs for medicine, offered clinical diagnosis and treatment to patients, and attracted princes and nobles who fought over her. Even the emperor addressed her with a respected title.

Humiliated, abandoned, and blamed for a marriage she never truly chose, Elysia dies with nothing but regret in her heart.
But fate grants her an impossible miracle.
She awakens once more at seventeen—the night the King intends to arrange her engagement to the very man who ruined her life.

Before the entire royal court, she crushes every rumor of her obsession with the Crown Prince and boldly declares her admiration for the kingdom’s most feared and untouchable nobleman: Cassiel Drakemont, the Duke of Draevenor.

i-was-the-hero-but-she-turned-me-into-th:
«Until death do us part.»
That was our vow.
And she kept it... by driving her sword through my chest.
I was a hero. A symbol. The one chosen by the gods to free humanity.
I fought for her. For us.
But in the end, it wasn’t the demons who killed me.
It was the woman I loved.
Helena betrayed me.
I fell with my heart shattered and my blood burning between my fingers.
But death wasn’t the end.
I woke up in another body, in another world...
No, not exactly.
I woke up inside the very story she wrote.
And now, I am Daven von Riesenhart:
the bastard son of a marquess, a noble outcast with a name no one respects, and a life I never asked for.
I no longer believe in ideals, in gods, or in happy endings.
I won’t fight for others.
I won’t die for anyone.
This time, I’ll live only for myself.
And if surviving means deceiving, betraying, or destroying...
so be it.
Even if it makes me the villain of this story.
infinite-wallet-system:
Riku Aoyama was just a broke, unlucky and starving college dropout waiting for his time and scraping by on instant noodles, and ended up as part-time buddy—until a mysterious vending machine offered him a deal: a system that lets him buy anything.
Want a skills? Check.
Looking for knowledge? Instantly downloaded.
Legendary weapons? Delivered to his door.
Authority, time, fate, even the affection of others? All up for sale—if he can pay the price.
With the Infinite Wallet System, Riku’s once-pathetic life turns into a wild ride of action, opportunity, and temptation. From unlocking forbidden martial arts to building a harem of powerful women drawn to his rising charisma, Riku is determined to forge an empire, one purchase at a time.
But every system has its cost. As he gains power, hidden forces begin to notice his ascent. Gods, demons, and beings beyond reality have started watching—and some want to claim the system for themselves.
Action-packed, hilarious, and mature, this is the story of a man who can buy everything—except his own peace of mind.

On a stormy night, Shen Jianian, her clothes tattered and torn, knelt down in a state of distress at the feet of the man’s trousers. Her face was pale as paper, her lips trembling as she pleaded, “Help me…”
Fu Jichen, the aloof magnate, lifts her like a stray cat and carries her to Rose Manor.
He feeds her, dresses her, teaches her music—then shows her off to a city that bets she’ll be discarded within weeks.
Bets lose.
Scratches bloom on his neck and cheek, proof the “kitten” has claws.
At midnight he trims those claws himself, whispering: “Stay.”
She vanishes, leaving only a hand-carved token and a note: A match made in heaven.
Fu Jichen tears the city apart to find his runaway cat—
and bring her home for good.

The first step, peeling; he gave the skin to Aphrodite.

“You were supposed to be born a male god and take over Zeus's position, but due to Zeus's shenanigans, you lost that seed, so here, have this core.”

“Phew… That hurt like hell…”
“It’s a bit of a shame to switch so soon… But I guess it is what it is.”
“Anyway, who should I become next?”
Actually, Lane Allen was not a Guide, but rather an Esper with a mysterious Plunder ability! It allowed him to possess other people’s bodies, and steal their awakened abilities. Keeping his real body safe, Lane could enjoy life to the fullest, constantly swapping identities, and doing whatever he wanted without ever worrying about the consequences! How great was that?
Except…
Damien Lennox grabbed Lane’s arm, and pressed him against the wall, his clear green eyes staring down at Lane intently, as if he could see right through him. “There’s no one else whose guidance feels so harsh and chaotic, yet pleasing at the same time.”
It seems that Damien was somehow able to recognize Lane even after switching identities, and is unwilling to let him go?
